title: Light Argentinian White Yam Wrap
description: A spicy and fluffy Argentinian dish featuring white yam, double-fry KFC style, and wrapped in a pandan leaf, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This satvik-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional Argentinian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, paprika, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Toss the diced white yam in the flour mixture to coat evenly.
Double-fry the coated white yam by frying it for 3 minutes, then letting it rest for 5 minutes, and finally frying it again for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the fried white yam on paper towels and sprinkle with lime juice.
Wash and dry the pandan leaves to prepare them for wrapping.
To assemble the wrap, place a few pieces of the fried white yam in the center of a pandan leaf, garnish with chopped cilantro, and fold the leaf to enclose the filling.
Serve the Light Argentinian White Yam Wrap immediately and enjoy.
To add extra flavor, serve with a side of your favorite Argentinian sauce or salsa.
